title: Oven-Roasted Crispy Light British Chicken Bake
description: A light and crispy British dish featuring chicken, sriracha, and a flaky gluten-free crust.
instructions: Line a slate tile with parchment paper for easy cleanup.
In a small bowl, mix together the melted butter, sriracha sauce, chopped onion, minced garlic, chopped thyme, and chopped rosemary.
Season the chicken breast with salt and black pepper.
Place the chicken breast in the center of the parchment-lined slate tile.
Brush the melted butter mixture evenly over the chicken breast.
Place the gluten-free puff pastry sheet over the chicken breast, pressing it gently to adhere.
Trim any excess pastry from the edges and crimp the edges to seal.
Use a sharp knife to make a few slits in the top of the pastry to allow steam to escape.
Bake the chicken bake for 25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the chicken bake from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
